record.original_question: Can one prove that hyperbolic 3-manifolds do not admit affine flat structures?

evidence.quote: Question 2.11. Can one prove that hyperbolic 3-manifolds do not admit affine flat structures ? The 2-dimensional case follows from Milnor’s result.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An affine flat structure on a smooth manifold $M^n$ is a maximal atlas of charts $\{(U_\alpha, \varphi_\alpha)\}$ with $\varphi_\alpha : U_\alpha 	o \mathbb{R}^n$ whose transition maps $\varphi_ eta \circ \varphi_\alpha^{-1}$ are restrictions of affine transformations $x \mapsto Ax + b$ of $\mathbb{R}^n$ (with $A \in \mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{R})$, $b \in \mathbb{R}^n$). Equivalently, $M$ admits a torsion-free flat affine connection on its tangent bundle. A hyperbolic 3-manifold is a complete Riemannian 3-manifold of constant sectional curvature $-1$; equivalently, a quotient $\Gamma  ackslash \mathbb{H}^3$ where $\Gamma \subset \mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^3)$ is a discrete torsion-free subgroup.

In dimension $2$, a result of Milnor implies that a closed surface admits an affine flat structure if and only if its Euler characteristic is zero; in particular, no closed hyperbolic surface admits an affine flat structure.

Problem. Prove that no closed hyperbolic 3-manifold admits an affine flat structure. That is, show that for every closed orientable 3-manifold $M$ carrying a complete hyperbolic Riemannian metric, the tangent bundle of $M$ does not admit any torsion-free flat affine connection.
artifact.status_search_result: The analogous 2-dimensional statement follows from Milnor's inequality. In dimension 3, while strong restrictions are known on fundamental groups of complete affine manifolds (Fried–Goldman, Abels–Margulis–Soifer), the question of whether a closed hyperbolic 3-manifold can carry any (not necessarily complete) affine flat structure does not appear to be settled in the literature surveyed; it is discussed in Goldman's surveys on locally homogeneous geometric structures as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Flat affine, projective and conformal structures on manifolds (Goldman survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses existence of affine structures on manifolds and lists hyperbolic 3-manifolds as a case where existence/nonexistence of affine structures is not known.
status_evidence.claim: The existence problem of affine flat structures on closed hyperbolic 3-manifolds is discussed as open.

status_evidence.title: Complete affine 3-manifolds and hyperbolic surfaces (Goldman)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses constraints on fundamental groups of complete affine 3-manifolds, but does not resolve existence of affine flat structures on hyperbolic 3-manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Known restrictions concern complete affine structures; the general (incomplete) case for hyperbolic 3-manifolds remains unresolved.
